STEP 5. Check the harness wires between driver's door 
switch connector D-11 and ETACS-ECU connector C-114.
NOTE: After checking junction block connector C-113, check 
the wires. If junction block connector C-113 are damaged, 
repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector 
Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Is the harness wires between the driver's door switch 
connector D-11 and ETACS-ECU connector C-114 in 
good condition?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The driver's door switch 
input signal should be able to be checked and the 
functions, which are described in the "Technical 
Description (comment)," should work normally.
NO : Repair them. The driver's door switch input signal 
should be able to be checked and the functions, 
which are described in the "Technical Description 
(comment)," should work normally.
